title: anthropic.container
description: Container info attached to an anthropic/messages response when a code-execution container served the request: the container id (reusable across requests to keep REPL state) and its expiry timestamp. Provider-unique server-side-tool infrastructure metadata with no canonical home; rides ChatResponse.extensions with an EXTENSIONS FieldLoss so it is preserved and reported, never silenced. The id is a candidate ProviderRef once container reuse is modeled as provider-anchored state.
x-ocai-promotion: promote to a ProviderRef(kind=container) anchor when the server-tool loop lands
